description.value: A Nelson institution since 1983, this family-owned diner on Baker Street is celebrated for fresh halibut fish and chips, authentic Greek specialties, aged AAA steaks, and gourmet burgers. Cyclists can eat inside or on what the restaurant bills as Nelson's first outdoor patio, with locally brewed draft beer, wine, and cocktails on offer. Its central downtown location makes it a natural refueling stop for riders passing through the Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms this is an active, long-established restaurant at 616 Baker St, Nelson, BC, with phone (250) 354-4848, corroborating the OSM-discovered URL. The business is clearly operational with a broad menu, outdoor patio, and downtown Nelson location suitable for a Food & Drink directory listing.
